Head_and_Face: Head is broad and slightly domed with moderate stop and strong square muzzle.
Ears are medium-sized, rounded at tips, set high, and folded forward.
Eyes are dark, medium-sized, and alert with keen expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Double-layered coat: hard wiry outer coat with soft undercoat, weather-resistant and close-lying.
Coloration is predominantly white with lemon, tan, blue, or badger-pied markings on head and ears.
Body is long, low, and sturdy with deep chest measuring 25-31 cm at shoulder.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are very short, straight, and heavy-boned with round compact feet.
Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried erect.
Gait is free, active, and ground-covering despite short legs.

Head_and_Face: Head is long and flat with moderate stop and strong square muzzle.
Ears are V-shaped, small, set high, and folded forward close to cheeks.
Eyes are dark, small, and alert with keen expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Dense, harsh, wiry outer coat with softer undercoat, close-lying and weather-resistant.
Coloration is tan body with black saddle (grizzle on shoulders), black or dark grizzle on neck and upper tail.
Distinctive beard and furnishings on face and legs.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight, muscular, and moderate-length with small compact feet.
Tail is set high and carried gaily.
Gait is free, active, and ground-covering with strong drive.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad and fox-like with moderate stop and strong muzzle.
Ears are small, pointed, set high, and carried erect.
Eyes are dark, medium-sized, and alert with keen terrier expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Double-layered coat: hard wiry outer coat with soft furry undercoat, weather-resistant and shaggy.
Coloration ranges from cream, wheaten, red, grey, to nearly black, often with darker muzzle and ears.
Shaggy unkempt appearance distinguishes from other small terriers.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are short, straight, and sturdy with compact feet.
Tail is short, set high, carried gaily, and well-covered with hair.
Gait is free, active, and ground-covering.

Head_and_Face: Head is long and flat with moderate stop and strong muzzle.
Ears are small, erect, pointed, and set high on head.
Eyes are dark, small, oval, and alert with keen expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Harsh, straight, wiry outer coat with soft undercoat, close-lying and weather-resistant.
Coloration is blue, steel blue, or dark grey with tan markings on face, ears, underbody, and legs; solid sandy or red also acceptable.
Similar to cairn terrier but with erect ears and longer body.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight, moderate-length, and well-boned with small compact feet.
Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried erect.
Gait is free, active, and ground-covering.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad with strong muzzle and moderate stop.
Ears are pendulous, set low, hanging close to cheeks, 7-10 cm long, with silky fringe.
Eyes are large, round, dark hazel, set wide apart with soft gentle expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Unique topknot of silky hair on head.
Coat is distinctive mixture of hard and soft hairs (linty texture), 5 cm long.
Coloration is pepper (dark bluish-black to light silver-grey) or mustard (reddish-brown to pale fawn).
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are short, sturdy, with distinctive hairy feet.
Tail is 20-25 cm, set low, carried curved over back.
Gait is free, active, and ground-covering.

Head_and_Face: Pug-faced (brachycephalic) appearance with square proportioned body.
Head is square and flat with short muzzle, definite stop, and wrinkled forehead.
Ears are small, erect, set high on head corners (bat ears).
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is short, smooth, fine-textured, and glossy.
Coloration is brindle, seal (black with red cast), or black with required white markings.
White muzzle band, blaze between eyes, chest, and front legs required.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight, well-boned, with compact feet.
Tail is short, set low, straight or screwed.
Gait is free, smooth, and even.

Head_and_Face: Bearded muzzle with bushy eyebrows and beard.
Head is rectangular with flat skull, moderate stop, and strong muzzle.
Eyes are dark brown, oval, and alert with keen expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Double-layered coat: hard wiry outer coat with soft undercoat, close-lying.
Coloration is solid black, black-and-silver, or salt-and-pepper (banded hairs creating grey appearance).
Distinctive furnishings: beard, eyebrows, and leg hair.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight, muscular, with oval compact feet.
Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried erect.
Gait is free, smooth, and ground-covering.

Head_and_Face: Bearded muzzle with bushy eyebrows and beard in large format.
Head is powerful and rectangular with flat skull, moderate stop, and strong muzzle.
Eyes are dark brown, oval, and alert with keen expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Double-layered coat: hard wiry outer coat with soft undercoat, close-lying and weather-resistant.
Coloration is solid black or pepper-and-salt (banded hairs creating grey appearance).
Distinctive furnishings: beard, eyebrows, and leg hair.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight, heavy-boned, and muscular with round compact feet.
Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried erect.
Largest of schnauzer breeds measuring 60-70 cm at shoulder.

Head_and_Face: Bearded muzzle with bushy eyebrows and beard.
Head is strong and rectangular with flat skull, moderate stop, and strong muzzle.
Eyes are dark brown, oval, and alert with keen expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Double-layered coat: hard wiry outer coat with soft undercoat, close-lying and weather-resistant.
Coloration is solid black or pepper-and-salt (banded hairs creating grey appearance).
Distinctive furnishings: beard, eyebrows, and leg hair.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight, muscular, and well-boned with oval compact feet.
Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried erect.
Medium size between miniature and giant schnauzer measuring 43-50 cm at shoulder.

Head_and_Face: Head is long in proportion to body with flat skull, moderate stop, and strong muzzle.
Ears are small, thin, pointed, set high on head, and carried erect.
Eyes are small, oval, dark, and set wide apart with keen alert expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Double-layered coat: hard wiry outer coat with soft dense undercoat, close-lying and weather-resistant.
Coloration is black, wheaten, or brindle.
Beard, eyebrows, and leg furnishings are characteristic.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are very short, straight, and heavy-boned with compact feet.
Tail is 18 cm, set high, carried erect, and thick.
Distinctive rolling gait.
